notes.title: Version v1.01 Update
notes.content:
First update for the game, here it is the patch notes:
- Corrected the problem that prevented saving the game when loading a game from main menu
- The starting language of the game is now selected from the Steam language (if connected) or from the system language (if Steam is not connected)
- Updated some not-translated italian texts in the main menu

Cheers and keep having fun!
